verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Summary of the year 2024 (pages 10-11); Consolidated statement of profit or loss (page 189)

candidate_sentences.text: In 2024, AS LHV Group achieved the highest business volumes and net profit in its history, reporting a consolidated net profit of EUR 150.3 million, representing a 7 percent increase year-over-year or an increase of EUR 9.4 million.

The Group’s total net income rose by 11 percent to EUR 338.3 million, supported by robust asset growth, efficient cost management, and sustained credit quality despite challenging macroeconomic conditions, including negative GDP growth in Estonia and a shifting interest rate environment.
Net interest income grew by 8 percent to EUR 273.3 million, while net fee and commission income rose by 24 percent to EUR 60.3 million.

Total operating expenses increased by 14 percent to EUR 146.9 million, driven largely by an increased number of employees, resulting in a cost-to-income ratio of 43.4 percent compared to 42.3 percent in the previous year.
Return on equity stood at 24.5 percent, and return on assets was 1.9 percent.

verified_key_information_units.information: The loan portfolio expanded by EUR 990 million (28% YoY) to EUR 4.6 billion, comprising Estonian corporate loans up 21% to EUR 2.3 billion, Estonian retail loans up 21% to EUR 1.9 billion, and UK SME loans up 338% to EUR 0.3 billion.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Summary of the year 2024 (page 10); Note 12, Loans and advances to customers (page 223)

candidate_sentences.text: The balance sheet expansion was propelled by a 28 percent growth in the net loan portfolio, which increased by EUR 990 million to EUR 4.6 billion.

verified_key_information_units.information: Deposits grew by EUR 1,179 million (21% YoY) to EUR 6.9 billion, with regular customer deposits in LHV Pank rising EUR 554 million (14% YoY to EUR 4.6 billion) and deposits from financial intermediaries increasing significantly (LHV Bank collections up EUR 416 million, +388% YoY), partly offset by LHV Pank reducing platform deposits by one-third.

candidate_sentences.text: Total customer deposits grew by 21 percent to EUR 6.9 billion, driven by growth across all customer segments, with regular customer deposits in LHV Pank increasing by 14 percent to EUR 4.6 billion, while financial intermediaries deposits reached EUR 1.5 billion.
